description: The MONROE project publishes mobile-broadband coverage measurements along Norwegian rail routes including Oslo to Stavanger, Oslo to Voss, Oslo to Trondheim and Trondheim to Bodø. Zenodo lists separate public CSVs by operator and route under CC0. The own page documents each route grid block, position, train speed, entry and exit times, radio-access-technology counts, no-service share, direction and tunnel or stop flags. A transport-telecom modeller could use these observations to compare service availability along rail corridors or test disruption-prone communication scenarios. The coverage reflects two operators and historical train traversals, not a continuous current signal map; the page does not specify every campaign date or passenger-device performance. Grid percentages should not be confused with measured application throughput. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this route-level dataset. The CSV files were not downloaded, so row counts, grid geometry and missing values remain unchecked.
